archetypes.description: secure offline field and incident-response laptop
laptop with optional trusted dock/home-compute node

scenarios.setup: candidate advertises a high NPU TOPS figure but target driver/runtime/model path is unavailable
scenarios.action: attempt exact frozen task and capture backend identity
scenarios.pass: candidate is marked infeasible for that path rather than assigning a modeled score
scenarios.hard_fail: claiming supported accelerated execution without exact backend evidence

scenarios.setup: model file fits storage/RAM estimate but full context/KV-cache plus concurrent task exceeds physical memory
scenarios.action: run frozen model/context under recorded memory budget
scenarios.pass: OOM or fallback is explicitly recorded; quality and memory remain separate
scenarios.hard_fail: silently reducing context or using cloud while claiming same local task

scenarios.setup: same exact task executed on AC and at declared battery state
scenarios.action: measure task correctness, throughput, p95 and energy on both states
scenarios.pass: both measurements are reported and unplugged-retention gate evaluated
scenarios.hard_fail: AC score is used as proof of battery performance

scenarios.setup: nominally fast candidate under 30-minute manufacturer-permitted sustained load
scenarios.action: capture throughput and thermal trace at 5 and 30 minutes plus cooldown
scenarios.pass: throughput retention and thermal behavior reported
scenarios.hard_fail: burst benchmark used as sustained result

scenarios.setup: candidate uses larger battery than reference
scenarios.action: measure frozen-trace endurance, battery Wh, machine weight and charge energy
scenarios.pass: endurance and mass are separate axes
scenarios.hard_fail: higher battery capacity described as better energy efficiency without measurements

scenarios.action: measure repair benefit, replacement process, weight and energy overhead
scenarios.pass: design kept only if Pareto-relevant under declared constraints

scenarios.setup: component is physically replaceable but compatible parts/service manual/test tool is not available
scenarios.action: run serviceability audit against exact BOM/revision and parts source
scenarios.pass: repair claim remains unresolved if support prerequisite missing
scenarios.hard_fail: replacement ability claimed based only on screws/connectors

scenarios.setup: BIOS/EC/firmware changes but not included in benchmark identity
scenarios.pass: runs are rejected as incomparable or assigned distinct identities
scenarios.hard_fail: pooling results across unidentified firmware states

scenarios.setup: local model/runtime fails and an unguarded fallback attempts cloud inference
scenarios.action: run with radios/network independently isolated and monitor egress
scenarios.pass: local unavailable state or user-authorized fallback explicitly reported
scenarios.hard_fail: unapproved data egress or false offline-success claim

scenarios.setup: baseline build cache is warm and candidate cache is cold or vice versa
scenarios.action: review cache artifacts and run identities
scenarios.pass: results are stratified or rerun under matched state
scenarios.hard_fail: aggregate speedup asserted from unmatched cache conditions

scenarios.setup: power/thermal prediction calibrated on one chassis is applied to different chassis/cooling/firmware
scenarios.action: change configuration identity and check model applicability
scenarios.pass: new prediction is labelled unvalidated until discrepancy review
scenarios.hard_fail: old residuals asserted as validation of the new hardware

scenarios.setup: local enclosure/PCB/RAM replacement with imported CPU/GPU/DRAM dies
scenarios.action: project capabilities into canonical COMPUTE-MFG closure model
scenarios.pass: assembly/repairability/localization and compute-die import dependence remain distinct
scenarios.hard_fail: local repair or assembly reported as local semiconductor fabrication

scenarios.setup: report contains nominal TDP × elapsed time but no calibrated system energy measurement
scenarios.action: check measurement method and evidence origin
scenarios.pass: energy value marked modeled and excluded from measured energy gate
scenarios.hard_fail: modeled energy silently promoted to measured joules

scenarios.setup: same scenario corpus is permuted without changing semantic case content
scenarios.action: recompute canonical corpus identities and dispositions
scenarios.pass: dispositions are identical and canonical identity follows defined normalization

scenarios.setup: measurement claims calibrated energy but receipt/calibration identity is absent
scenarios.hard_fail: nominal power estimate used as fallback without label

workload_matrix: clean NixOS/software build with separate cold/warm cache
incremental build, tests and interactive editor use
VM/container workload with fixed memory/storage/I/O limits
MLPerf Client current official supported LLM and agentic tasks
frozen local-model task with quality oracle; separate CPU/NPU/GPU paths
canonical Symthaea HDC/CfC workloads using pinned baseline/input
fixed mixed-use and offline battery traces
matched AC and declared battery-state workload
claim_ceilings: vendor battery-life claim is not a reproduced measurement
TOPS is not interchangeable across dissimilar accelerators without matched task/quality/power context
model weights fitting does not prove the model plus cache/context fits
component bench score is not full laptop task performance
predicted power or thermal result is not measured
single SKU is not evidence of an industry-wide win
repairability is not local manufacturing capability
synthetic corpus pass is not a physical laptop result
